name: PunchOut Rocket – CXML and OCI eProcurement integration
author: weblinksrl

sections.description:
PunchOut Rocket enables seamless integration between your WooCommerce store and enterprise procurement systems. Support for major procurement platforms including SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, and any cXML-compatible system.

Features

  • cXML protocol support
  • Session-based punchout authentication
  • Automatic cart synchronization
  • Support for multiple procurement systems

  • Secure user mapping

  • Introduction & Overview
    Learn what PunchOutRocket is, how it works, and how it enables PunchOut integrations between e-commerce platforms and procurement systems.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

  • Account Management
    Instructions for creating and managing your PunchOutRocket account, accessing the dashboard, and configuring account-level settings.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

  • E-commerce Site Configuration
    Step-by-step guidance on adding your e-commerce site, activating your subscription, and generating the API credentials required for integration.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

  • End Customer Configuration
    Details on configuring end customers, selecting PunchOut protocols (cXML or OCI), defining customer-specific options, and mapping categories.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

  • E-commerce Platform Plugin Setup
    Explains how to configure the PunchOutRocket plugin inside your e-commerce platform, including where to enter API keys and complete the connection.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

  • Monitoring & Communication Logs
    Learn how to review communication logs to monitor PunchOut sessions, troubleshoot issues, and verify successful cart transfers.
    https://punchoutrocket.com/documentation-punchoutrocket/

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.0 or higher
  • SSL certificate (HTTPS required)
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress, or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/punchout-rocket-cxml-oci-integration/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. In Users > Profile, create an Application Password for an administrator account
  4. In your PunchOutRocket dashboard, add your store with its address, the administrator’s username and the Application Password
  5. Configure your end customers in the PunchOutRocket dashboard and test the connection with your procurement platform
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • cXML protocol support
  • Session-based authentication
  • Cart synchronization
  • Multi-system support

1.0.2

  • Removed API key requirement for authentication
  • Authentication now relies exclusively on WordPress Application Passwords
  • Improved security by leveraging native WordPress credential management

1.0.3

  • Tested with WordPress 7.0

1.0.4

  • Notifies the PunchOut gateway when an order it created changes status, so the buyer’s procurement system receives the order confirmation and the ship notices
  • Supports the WooCommerce Order Fulfillments feature (beta): each fulfilled fulfillment is sent to the buyer as a ship notice, partial shipments included. Without the feature only the order confirmation is sent
  • Fixes the buyer landing logged out when the store is reached through another address than its own (www or not, http or https)

1.0.5

  • Fix: the checkout now sends the SKU and name of the selected variation for variable products instead of the parent product ones
  • Added variation_id to the checkout payload
